versions.changelog: Security fix: Added path validation to prevent malicious file writes. Export function now restricts output to safe directories (workspace, home, /tmp) and blocks system paths and sensitive dotfiles. Addresses vulnerability reported by VirusTotal scan.

Initial release - Persistent task management across sessions. Features: add tasks with projects and priorities, list pending/completed tasks, mark tasks complete, export projects to markdown. Perfect for multi-session projects and maintaining productivity.
